name: LightPlan
subtitle: Plan around the light
promotional_text: Mark a subject on the map, see when the Sun or Moon aligns with it, and search up to 90 days for a shooting opportunity.
description: LightPlan is a paid app: purchase it on the App Store before downloading, then use all planning features without in-app purchases or a subscription. No app account is required. See sunrise, sunset, golden and blue-hour windows in your destination’s time zone. Explore Sun and Moon directions on a map, search alignment opportunities over a chosen range of up to 90 days, and compare geometric shooting-position suggestions. Save photo plans and places, choose reminders and use the widget. Astronomical calculations work offline for known coordinates and time zones; maps and place search may need a connection. Times and alignments are model estimates: clouds, buildings and terrain can change what you see.
screenshot_captions: Choose a place and date, explore sun and moon directions, and prepare your next photo session.
